name: Document check
summary: Keep the text of a submission's document and look its company up in a business registry.

dataHandling.purpose: Checking submissions against a business registry
dataHandling.retention: As long as the organization keeps its submissions
recipients: registry.example.com receives each submission's registry code

changelog: First release: the Submission entity, a Check action and the Check a submission workflow.

parameters.label: Submission users
parameters.help: Everyone who records and checks submissions. Give its members a role with entity.read, entity.list and entity.write: a role does not come from a group.

parameters.label: Registry API key
parameters.help: The stored secret holding the business registry's API key. The Check workflow sends it as a bearer token to registry.example.com only.

egress.purpose: Looking up a submission's company in the business registry
